name: kg_delete_node
description: Permanently delete a KG node AND all its edges. DESTRUCTIVE. Audited: requires a non-empty `reason`, refuses user-locked nodes (and nodes with user-locked edges), snapshots the node + every attached edge into kg_revision_log so the deletion can be reverted, and removes the node's label/context embeddings from Chroma. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview the node + edge count without committing. Best practice: describe the node first to confirm it's the right one; for duplicates prefer kg_merge_nodes (preserves history instead of destroying it).

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: UUID of the node to delete.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why this deletion is correct. Goes into kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Preview what would be deleted; do not commit. Default false.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, deleted_node_id, edges_deleted, chroma_cleaned} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_delete_node:
- node_id (required): UUID of the node to delete
- reason (required): why this deletion is correct
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding row id

Example:
{
    "node_id": "abc-123-def-456",
    "reason": "Hallucinated node — no evidence row references it"
}
